# Legacy export → ECG Record crosswalk

How each value of the legacy `to_dict` export maps to an ECG Record address (`ecg-record:<record_id>@<schema_version>#<pointer>`). Source: `schemas/ecg-record/1.0/crosswalk-legacy-v0.json`, the same table the parity gate uses.

## Record-level fields

| Record pointer | Legacy pointer | Transform |
|---|---|---|
| `/measurements/global/heart_rate_bpm` | `/global_features/heart_rate_bpm` | round_half_even |
| `/measurements/global/frontal_qrs_axis_deg` | `/global_features/qrs_axis_deg` | round_half_even |
| `/measurements/global/qtc_bazett_ms` | `/global_features/qtc_bazett_ms` | round_half_even |
| `/measurements/global/qrs_wide_ms` | `/global_features/qrs_wide_ms` | round_half_even |
| `/axes/beats/*/r_sample` | `/beats/*/r_index` | native_sample |
| `/quality/record/grade` | `/metadata/record_quality/record_grade` | identity |
| `/quality/record/status` | `/metadata/record_quality/record_grade` | grade_in_Q0_Q1_usable_else_limited |
| `/quality/leads/<lead>/status` | `/quality/<slot>/reliable` | true_usable_else_limited(reason quality_gate) |
| `/provenance/internal_sample_rate_hz` | `/fs` | float |
| `/provenance/mains_frequency_hz` | `/metadata/mains_frequency_hz` | identity |
| `/debug/legacy_metadata/<key>` | `/metadata/<key>` | json_safe |

## Transforms

- **native_sample**: round_half_even(v * acquisition.sample_rate_hz / legacy fs); a result outside [0, sample_count) -> unmeasurable(sample_outside_acquisition)
- **round_half_even**: round_half_even(v)
- **mv_to_uv**: round_half_even(v * 1000)
- **mv_internal_sample_to_uv_ms**: round_half_even(v * 1_000_000 / legacy fs)

## Legacy sections without a record 1.0 equivalent

- `fs`: mapped: /provenance/internal_sample_rate_hz (engine rate); native rate is /acquisition/sample_rate_hz
- `quality`: partially mapped: per-lead reliability -> /quality/leads/<lead>/status; detailed quality diagnostics are not in record 1.0
- `beats`: mapped: beat axis /axes/beats (ids b0001.., r_sample in native samples)
- `beat_features`: partially mapped: the 18 summary + 2 all-profile per-beat/per-lead fields above; the other legacy per-beat keys are unpublished in 1.0 (debug/provenance/implementation per document 02 section C)
- `representative_leads`: not in record 1.0: implementation intermediate (document 02 section B); legacy consumers read it through ecgfeat.compat.export_v0 during the compatibility window
- `groups`: not in record 1.0: implementation intermediate
- `global_features`: partially mapped: heart_rate_bpm, qrs_axis_deg, qtc_bazett_ms, qrs_wide_ms; other global values are unpublished in 1.0
- `p_wave_assessments`: not in record 1.0: intermediate assessment (document 02 section A.1)
- `metadata`: partially mapped: record_quality grade, mains_frequency_hz, and (debug profile) input_contract, limited_lead_capabilities, refinement_config; pacing/QT policy metadata becomes structured policy provenance in the staged pipeline
- `interpretation`: removed: interpretation document (separate schema/distribution)
- `clinical_interpretation`: removed: interpretation document (separate schema/distribution)
- `statement_engine`: removed: interpretation document (separate schema/distribution)
- `rhythm_inputs`: not in record 1.0: implementation input for interpretation (document 02 section B)
- `morphology_inputs`: not in record 1.0: implementation input for interpretation (document 02 section B)
- `reference_metadata`: not in record 1.0: provenance of the legacy exporter
